title: Owl dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='100' height='100'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='92' rx='28' ry='5' fill='#2a1a4a' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- dancing legs -->
  <rect x='33' y='76' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#f5a623' transform='rotate(-15 36 76)'/>
  <rect x='61' y='76' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#f5a623' transform='rotate(15 64 76)'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='90' rx='7' ry='3.5' fill='#ffcc33' transform='rotate(-15 30 90)'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='90' rx='7' ry='3.5' fill='#ffcc33' transform='rotate(15 70 90)'/>

  <!-- tail feathers -->
  <path d='M40 74 L35 88 L45 80 Z' fill='#7b5ea7'/>
  <path d='M60 74 L65 88 L55 80 Z' fill='#7b5ea7'/>
  <path d='M50 76 L50 90 L55 82 Z' fill='#9b7ec7' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='24' ry='26' fill='#8b5e3c'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='64' rx='15' ry='18' fill='#d4a373'/>
  <!-- belly feather pattern -->
  <path d='M42 56 q4 4 8 0' stroke='#b07d52' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M50 54 q4 4 8 0' stroke='#b07d52' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M42 64 q4 4 8 0' stroke='#b07d52' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M50 62 q4 4 8 0' stroke='#b07d52' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M44 72 q4 4 8 0' stroke='#b07d52' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>

  <!-- wings raised (dancing) -->
  <path d='M26 52 Q10 30 14 20 Q22 28 30 42 Z' fill='#6b4226'/>
  <path d='M74 52 Q90 30 86 20 Q78 28 70 42 Z' fill='#6b4226'/>
  <!-- wing feather lines -->
  <path d='M20 38 Q22 44 28 48' stroke='#8b5e3c' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M80 38 Q78 44 72 48' stroke='#8b5e3c' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='32' rx='22' ry='20' fill='#8b5e3c'/>
  <!-- ear tufts -->
  <path d='M32 18 L26 6 L38 12 Z' fill='#6b4226'/>
  <path d='M68 18 L74 6 L62 12 Z' fill='#6b4226'/>

  <!-- facial disc -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='34' rx='17' ry='15' fill='#d4a373'/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='32' r='8' fill='#ffdd66'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='32' r='8' fill='#ffdd66'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='32' r='4.5' fill='#2a1a4a'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='32' r='4.5' fill='#2a1a4a'/>
  <!-- eye shine -->
  <circle cx='40.5' cy='30.5' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='56.5' cy='30.5' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- beak -->
  <path d='M47 40 L50 47 L53 40 Z' fill='#f5a623'/>

  <!-- eyebrows (dancing expression) -->
  <path d='M34 24 Q40 20 46 23' stroke='#6b4226' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M66 24 Q60 20 54 23' stroke='#6b4226' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- musical notes -->
  <g fill='#ff66cc'>
    <path d='M78 14 L78 24 M78 14 L86 12 L86 22'/>
    <circle cx='76' cy='24' r='3'/>
    <circle cx='84' cy='22' r='3'/>
    <rect x='78' y='12' width='1.5' height='12' fill='#ff66cc' stroke='none'/>
    <rect x='84' y='10' width='1.5' height='12' fill='#ff66cc' stroke='none'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#66ffcc'>
    <circle cx='18' cy='16' r='2.5'/>
    <rect x='19.5' y='7' width='1.5' height='10' fill='#66ffcc'/>
    <path d='M19.5 7 Q26 6 26 10' stroke='#66ffcc' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  </g>

  <!-- sparkle -->
  <path d='M28 10 l1 3 l3 1 l-3 1 l-1 3 l-1-3 l-3-1 l3-1 z' fill='#ffee88'/>
</svg>
